text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I was entrusted with an important task.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A collaboration event between Tracen 
Academy and a famous sports manufacturer. 
Tracen's horse girls were to introduce the 
new products at the event, but—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. So this is that cutting-edge giant 
tire for rope pulling, huh?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
They say it has 108 new features. Really 
gets my inner gadget geek tingling~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My role is to coach the horse girls 
participating in the event. But how 
exactly should we showcase this new 
product...?
choice_data_list:
(Will I really be able to pull this 
off...?)

(Will I really be able to pull this 
off...?)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
You'll be fine. I know you can do it, 
Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Wanting to entertain everyone, wanting 
them to see the quality of the product... 
Your earnest feelings will definitely 
reach them, desu ne.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
So, just like during that diet... let's do 
our best together! Ganbarou!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, everyone gathered in front of the 
giant new-model tire resting in a corner 
of the course.
choice_data_list:
...Where should we start showcasing it, I 
wonder?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
First things first, let's share our ideas 
together. I'll take notes for everyone 
afterward!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Either way, we absolutely have to show off 
its main feature, the transformation 
function, desu ne.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see. According to the specs, the 
lightest setting is "Water Flea Mode," and 
the heaviest is "Mammoth Mode."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
It's training equipment, right? Don't 
underestimate it— we gotta try using it 
first or we won't get anywhere!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah! In that case, I'll try pulling it once 
for starters!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Led by the proactive Buena Vista, everyone 
worked together, and preparations 
progressed swiftly—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Our demonstration plan is taking shape, 
desu ne. Fufu, I'm looking forward to the 
big day.
choice_data_list: Sorry I couldn't be of much help
Sorry I couldn't be of much help

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: No, no! That's not true at all.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
When I look at you, Trainer-san... your 
feelings come right through to me. Your 
desire to give it your all.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I receive so much positive energy from you 
like that. If anything, I'm the one who 
should be thanking you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista, always staying so close to my 
heart... And then, the day of the event 
finally arrived.

text_block_list.name: Audience
text_block_list.text: (Chatter, chatter... murmur, murmur...)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Man oh man, that's way more of a crowd 
than expected. Talk about high stakes...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hah! No way I'm gettin' cold feet over 
somethin' like this! Let's get this over 
with quick!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Everyone's nervous tension is palpable. 
I'm feeling the same way. But... Buena 
Vista is right by my side—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I-It's... going to be okay, desu! If we 
just stick to the rehearsal, surely...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
To everyone who has gathered here today to 
see the new training tire...! W-Well 
then... w-we shall begin, desu!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Come to think of it, Buena Vista has 
always empathized deeply with how I felt. 
In every little thing, as if it were her 
own—
choice_data_list:
Don't tell me... my nerves rubbed off on 
her...?!

Don't tell me... my nerves rubbed off on 
her...?!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
F-First, we launch the dedicated control 
app ...um... errr...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: H-Here!

text_block_list.name: New Hi-Tech Tire
text_block_list.text: (Whirrrr! Clank-clank!)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, hold on?! Buena-chan, that switch is 
for Underwater Navigation Mode!

text_block_list.name: New Hi-Tech Tire
text_block_list.text: ...DESTROY...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: That's the switch for Berserker Mode!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Um... Emergency Stop!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Despite some rather perilous close 
calls, we somehow managed to get through 
the program—

text_block_list.name: Departing Audience
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm... that was actually pretty good, 
wasn't it?" "I guess... I might buy 
one..." "For a second there, I thought the 
school building was gonna get smashed..."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: —Good work, everyone.
choice_data_list:
I-I'm so sorry... It ended up being such a 
mess...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sorry. If only I hadn't gotten so 
nervous—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
It's alright! Overall reception was very 
positive, and the client company was quite 
pleased as well...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I suppose seeing it through to the end was 
a victory in itself ...Still, if there's a 
next time, I'll do my best to do even 
better.
